summary.name: StandWithUkraine
summary.one_liner: A GitHub Pages list of ways to support Ukraine, including donation links to military and humanitarian charities, plus calls to action for open source developers.
use_cases: Finding charities to donate to for Ukraine
Adding a Ukraine support banner to open source projects
Identifying vetted humanitarian and military aid organizations
Learning how to take action against the war
summary.what_it_does: The page is a civic resource listing ways to financially support Ukraine. It recommends donating to accounts opened by the National Bank of Ukraine, to United24, and to military and humanitarian campaigns. It also lists about two dozen non-profits working in Ukraine, with some marked as 501(c)(3) with tax IDs. It gives guidance such as avoiding unofficial crypto wallets and not donating to International Red Cross instead of the Ukrainian Red Cross. The rest of the page urges readers to add banners to open source projects, boycott Russian businesses and software, and resist propaganda.
notable: Lists donation channels with US 501(c)(3) tax IDs for several charities
Written for open source developers, with suggestions to add banners to projects
Warns against unofficial crypto wallets and International Red Cross donations
Includes a short message addressed to Russian citizens
caveats: Page content is a list of recommendations and does not verify charity status beyond the listed tax IDs
Some listed items are calls to action rather than software features
